title: Diwali 2026: The Festival of Lights
description: Diwali celebration at the University of Alaska Fairbanks on Saturday, November 14, 2026, in the Wood Center's Carol Brown Ballroom, listed on UAF's official public events calendar (9:00 AM - 11:00 PM, public and student activities). Diwali, also known as Deepavali ('row of oil lamps'), is one of the most widely celebrated festivals across India and the globe, symbolising the victory of light over darkness, good over evil, and knowledge over ignorance.
